conversation_threads_scope_workspace_che.name: conversation_threads_scope_workspace_check
conversation_threads_scope_workspace_che.value: ("conversation_threads"."scope" = 'home' and "conversation_threads"."workspace_id" is null) or ("conversation_threads"."scope" = 'workspace' and "conversation_threads"."workspace_id" is not null)

provider_configurations_base_url_check.name: provider_configurations_base_url_check

study_sessions_end_check.name: study_sessions_end_check
study_sessions_end_check.value: ("study_sessions"."status" = 'active' and "study_sessions"."ended_at" is null) or ("study_sessions"."status" = 'completed' and "study_sessions"."ended_at" is not null)

workspace_study_states_timer_started_che.name: workspace_study_states_timer_started_check
workspace_study_states_timer_started_che.value: ("workspace_study_states"."timer_status" = 'running' and "workspace_study_states"."timer_started_at" is not null) or ("workspace_study_states"."timer_status" != 'running' and "workspace_study_states"."timer_started_at" is null)

workspaces_archive_consistency_check.name: workspaces_archive_consistency_check
workspaces_archive_consistency_check.value: ("workspaces"."status" = 'active' and "workspaces"."archived_at" is null) or ("workspaces"."status" = 'archived' and "workspaces"."archived_at" is not null)
